name: Tribesman
description: Hunter-spearmen with fire-hardened pikes. The first defenders of the settlement, and its last resort.

name: Slinger
description: Whirls a river stone at anything within a few paces. Quick to raise, easy to replace.

name: Stone Bowman
description: Flint-tipped arrows fly further than any thrown stone, and can reach a bird in flight.

name: Wolf
description: Hunts in a pack and closes fast. Nothing a trained line cannot handle, and nothing a lone hunter can.

name: Bear
description: Half a ton of muscle and claw. Slow to rouse, and it does not stop when it is hurt.

name: Dugout Canoe
description: A dugout hull for river and coast. Carries a raiding party, and nothing heavier.

name: Bronze Spearman
description: Bronze heads on long shafts, braced against cavalry. The point is meant for armour.

name: Bronze Axeman
description: Heavy bronze axes for close work; no shield line survives them for long.

name: Bronze Chariot
description: Two horses, a driver and a fighting platform. Terrifying in the open, useless in a bog.

name: Bronze Bowman
description: Bronze-tipped arrows in massed volleys. Cheap damage at a safe distance.

name: Bronze Galley
description: Bronze-age galley packed with rowers and a ram at the waterline.

name: Catapult
description: Torsion artillery that lobs stones over a wall and through a shield line.

name: Iron Spearman
description: Iron-pointed pikes for the phalanx. Cheaper than bronze and harder to blunt.

name: Iron Swordsman
description: Short iron blade and a big shield; the workhorse of the first iron armies.

name: Iron Chariot
description: An iron-age chariot with a heavier crew and a longer reach than its bronze ancestor.

name: Iron Cavalry
description: Riders who fight from the saddle rather than riding to the fight. Speed is the armour.

name: War Galley
description: A decked galley with an iron-shod ram, built to sink rather than to board.

name: War Elephant
description: A war elephant with a howdah on its back. Breaks a line by weight alone.

name: Ballista
description: Bolt-throwing engine on a wooden frame. Long range, slow to reload, indifferent to arrows.

name: Quinquereme
description: Five banks of oars and a reinforced bow; the heaviest ram afloat in its age.

name: Legionary
description: Drilled infantry who can hold a line, throw, and rotate under pressure.

name: Hoplite
description: Shield-wall infantry with a long spear and heavy panoply. Unbeaten head-on.

name: Companion Cavalry
description: Companion cavalry: the decisive shock charge aimed at a gap, not the front.

name: Composite Archer
description: Composite bow shooting from a horse or a hill; range and mobility together.

name: Onager
description: Arm-throwing engine that arcs a stone into a fortified position.

name: Fire Ship
description: A hull packed with pitch and set alight, steered into an enemy fleet.

name: Assassin
description: A single blade in the right tent. Fragile, fast, and lethal to a commander.

name: Trade Galley
description: A trade galley with wide holds and a small crew. Barely fights, but sails anywhere.

name: Knight
description: Plate armour, a lance and a destrier. The dominant shock arm of its age.

name: Longbowman
description: Yew bows with a high draw weight: massed arrow storms at long range.

name: Crossbowman
description: Slow to span, but a bolt punches through mail at close range.

name: Man-at-Arms
description: Professional infantry with mail, spear and poleaxe; the core of a medieval host.

name: Trebuchet
description: Counterweight engine that drops a stone onto a wall from far beyond bowshot.

name: Cog
description: Broad-hulled trader turned transport. Carries an army's baggage and its horses.

name: Longship
description: Shallow-draught hull that rows up a river and beaches without a harbour.

name: Bombard Cannon
description: Early gunpowder artillery, enormous and slow, built to break stone gates.

name: Caravel
description: Lateen-sailed hull that can beat upwind; explores and raids far from home.

name: Musketeer
description: Black-powder volleys in ranks. Terrifying to cavalry, helpless in the rain.

name: Tercio Pikeman
description: Pike and shot's other half: a hedge of points that keeps cavalry at bay.

name: Dragoon - Renaissance
description: Mounted infantry who ride to the fight and shoot from the ground on arrival.

name: Cuirassier
description: Heavy cavalry in steel breastplates, charging home in a single mass.

name: Field Cannon
description: Mobile field gun with an iron barrel. Shreds formations and siege works alike.

name: Galleon
description: Ocean-going hull with heavy timbers and a broadside of guns.

name: Sailing Frigate
description: Fast sailing warship built for escort, patrol and raiding rather than the line.

name: Privateer
description: A licensed raider: light guns, deep holds, and a crew paid in plunder.

name: Line Infantry
description: Bayoneted muskets and formal drill. Holds a line by discipline alone.

name: Rifleman
description: Rifled barrels and aimed fire; kills at ranges the old muskets only hoped for.

name: Dragoon - Industrial
description: Mounted infantry with modern carbines: mobility plus firepower.

name: Lancer
description: Horse cavalry with a long lance, still useful in the charge's last decades.

name: Gatling Gun
description: Hand-cranked multibarrel gun. Devastating in a fixed position, quick to jam.

name: Ironclad
description: Iron-plated hull with a revolving turret and no sails at all.

name: Zeppelin
description: Rigid airship for observation and night bombing. Slow, huge, and vulnerable.

name: Biplane
description: Canvas and wire fighter; it owns the air until something faster appears.

name: Howitzer
description: Indirect-fire artillery that drops shells into trenches behind a ridge.

name: Early Submarine
description: A petrol-driven boat that attacks unseen, and sinks if it is seen.

name: WW1 Infantry
description: Bolt-action rifle, entrenching tool and gas mask; a war of attrition in one soldier.

name: WW2 Infantry
description: Semi-automatic rifles, grenades and radios: the first fully modern foot soldier.

name: Dragoon - Motorized
description: Halftrack-borne infantry: they arrive with the armour and fight with it.

name: Sherman Tank
description: Medium tank with an all-round turret; armour becomes an arm of decision, not infantry support.

name: P-51 Fighter
description: Piston fighter with self-sealing tanks and heavy machine guns; escorts what it fights.

name: B-17 Bomber
description: Heavy four-engine bomber. Carries a city's worth of ordnance, and needs a fighter screen.

name: Battleship
description: Steel hull, armour belt and 16-inch rifles. A fleet is built around it.

name: Carrier WW2
description: A flight deck on a hull. Its punch is the aircraft it carries, not its guns.

name: Modern Soldier
description: Assault rifle, body armour and a radio: one soldier who is also a sensor.

name: Abrams Tank
description: Composite-armour main battle tank with a stabilised gun that hits on the move.

name: F-35 Fighter
description: Supersonic multirole jet with radar-guided missiles. Owns the air outright.

name: Burke Destroyer
description: Guided-missile destroyer: air defence, anti-submarine work and precision strikes in one hull.

name: Dragoon - Modern Armored Cavalry
description: Armoured cavalry with thermal sights: scouts, screens and flank guards for the tank force.

name: Reaper Drone
description: Unmanned aircraft loitering overhead, finding targets and striking them from above.

name: Apache Helicopter
description: Rotary-wing gunship that hunts armour from behind a treeline.

name: M270 MLRS
description: Multiple-launch rocket system. One salvo covers a grid square, and then it moves.

name: Nuclear Submarine
description: Nuclear attack submarine. Stays under for months and sinks what it is sent for.

name: Nuclear Carrier
description: Nuclear-powered carrier: an airbase that sails, with the escorts to survive it.

name: Special Forces
description: Small teams behind the lines. Trains, bridges and commanders disappear.

name: Stealth Bomber
description: Radar-absorbent flying wing. Arrives before anyone knows it is over the border.

name: Military Satellite
description: Military satellite: it watches, listens and directs. Nothing can reach it at all.

name: Orbital Laser
description: Orbital beam platform. Reaches anything on the far side of the planet.

name: Mech Suit
description: One pilot in layered armour carrying a cannon. Walks through whatever it is aimed at.

name: Starship Trooper
description: A trooper that flies and fights in vacuum, carrying a division's firepower in one suit.
